english.title: Candidate/agent print/publish/promote publication re candidate without printer/publisher details on single sheet
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of an illegal practice in that being

(A)_[a candidate]_
(B)_[an election agent of a candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE..),]_

at an election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..), you were

(C)_[the promoter of material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure your election at that election and which was published in a document consisting of, or principally consisting of, a single side of printed matter]_
(D)_[the promoter of material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure the election of that candidate at the election and which was published in a document consisting of, or principally consisting of, a single side of printed matter]_
(E)_[the publisher of material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure your election at that election and was in a document consisting of, or principally consisting of, a single side of printed matter]_
(F)_[the publisher of material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure the election of that candidate at the election and was in a document consisting of, or principally consisting of, a single side of printed matter]_
(G)_[the printer of a document consisting of a single side of printed matter and containing material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure your election at that election]_
(H)_[the printer of a document consisting of a single side of printed matter and containing material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure the election of that candidate at the election]_

when

(I)_[your name and address]_
(J)_[the name and address of the printer of the document]_
(K)_[the name and address of the promoter of the material]_
(L)_[the name and address of a person on behalf of whom the material was being published]_
(M)_[**(..SPECIFY COMBINATION OF ABOVE..)]_

did not appear on the face of that document
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 110(2)(a), (4), (9) and (12) and 169 of the Representation of the People Act 1983.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see section 176

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
